verified: Microsoft announced seven in-house MAI models at Ignite covering code, security, images, language and routing, and its own announcement states that MAI Code 2 reaches 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's coding performance at 40% of the cost, while MAI Code 2 Flash matches GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at 65% and 20% of their cost respectively (Microsoft, as reported by Techzine).
unconfirmed: The 98%/40% and Flash figures are vendor benchmarks with no independent replication reported, and one outside analysis frames the comparison as being against a deprecated model (OrcaRouter), which would change how the cost-performance claim should be read. The report's core assertion that Microsoft is replacing external models inside its own products is attributed only to reporting rather than a named shipping commitment, and the announcement gives no per-token pricing, rollout dates, or list of affected products.

verified: 微软 MAI 在 Ignite 上发布七款面向代码、安全、图像、语言和路由的模型；微软官方称 MAI Code 2 在编码任务上达到 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 98% 性能、成本仅为其 40%，并称该模型正成为微软产品背后的主力模型（来源：微软 MAI 发布页、The Decoder）。
unconfirmed: “用自研模型替换产品中的外部模型”涉及哪些具体产品、替换规模和上线时间，报道未给出完整清单；98%/40% 是微软自报的基准与成本口径，尚无独立第三方复测，七款模型的定价与开放范围也未披露。

titles.en: Microsoft's MAI unveils seven models as products reportedly shift in-house
titles.zh: 微软 Ignite 发布七款 MAI 自研模型，以更低成本替代外部模型
